fixed_syntax_rule.context: One Eq atom or one predicate atom from the original declared signature. No connective or binder inside the context. At least one occurrence of exactly one hole name; it is not an original parameter. Repeated occurrences use the SAME simultaneous term.
fixed_syntax_rule.counting: Each term constructor/variable is one node; atom adds one. Term-root depth is zero. Template and both grounded donor atoms must satisfy bounds; recipient input/template/output atoms too. Left/right and recipient slot terms have the same64-node/16-depth term bound.
fixed_syntax_rule.typing: Original nominal function/predicate names and literal integer arities. Hole-free variables must be original declared parameters; Hilbert remains closed. No new sort axioms, induction, quantifier rule or primitive licence.
fixed_syntax_rule.abstraction: Preserve atomic head and function symbols on paths to holes. Replace each maximal hole-free term by a typed slot; exact repeated whole terms share a slot, whole terms equal to source s/t retain that correlation. No sequential replacement inside inserted terms. No fixed successor or right-one clause is encoded.
fixed_syntax_rule.unsupported: No hole, binder/connective, undeclared variables, wrong arity, bound overflow, same training left/right term, missing licensed recipe or unavailable greedy embedding stays ineligible/NoInstance. This does not prune the base universe.

data_driven_requirement: Every family still requires an actually searched, original-target independently checked donor word authenticated by ROOT. Actual eq_subst then two ordered MP ancestors are recognized at each root. All abstract member witnesses, ordered inputs, output and template must ground back exactly to the checked donor. No donor word or family library is bundled; author has seen the previous saved right-one result, so this is a new declared scope chosen AFTER that observation and BEFORE any execution of this successor, not a retrospective preregistration.
